judge.rationale: The candidate only completed the test-writing and spec-updating step, completely failing to modify `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to implement the fix. Because the production code still gates `onError` on `error instanceof Error`, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately. Furthermore, the candidate did not update `CHANGELOG.md` as required by the acceptance criteria (and its own DoD), and left behind a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file. While the spec edit in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and the test assertions themselves accurately capture the requirements, the core bug remains unfixed.
